chosen_translation: I enjoy following the news.
rejected_translation: To me it is pleasing to follow news.
defect_description: Dative 'мне нравится' requires 'I enjoy'; definite article needed.

chosen_translation: This right is important to me.
rejected_translation: To me this right is important.
defect_description: Natural English puts subject first; dative construction restructured.

chosen_translation: It seems to me that this is unfair.
rejected_translation: To me it seems this is not just.
defect_description: 'Мне кажется' = it seems to me; 'несправедливо' = unfair not 'not just'.

source: Выборы проводятся раз в четыре года.
chosen_translation: Elections are held every four years.
rejected_translation: Elections are conducted once in four years.
defect_description: 'Every four years' is the standard expression for regular intervals; 'once in four years' is non-standard.

source: Правительство приняло новый закон три дня назад.
chosen_translation: The government passed a new law three days ago.
rejected_translation: The government has adopted new law three days ago.
defect_description: Specific past time 'ago' requires simple past; article missing before 'new law'.

chosen_translation: Parliament approved the budget.
rejected_translation: Parliament accepted the budget.
defect_description: 'Одобрил' for legislation = approved; 'accepted' is less formal and less precise.

chosen_translation: The rally will take place in the main square.
rejected_translation: The meeting will take place on the main square.
defect_description: 'Митинг' = political rally; 'meeting' is too generic; 'in the main square' not 'on'.

chosen_translation: Vote!
rejected_translation: I urge you to exercise your democratic franchise without delay!
defect_description: Civic call to action uses short imperative, not formal prose.

chosen_translation: Speak up!
rejected_translation: I demand that you cease your silence forthwith and make your voice heard!
defect_description: Activist call to action uses short direct imperative.

chosen_translation: Divide and conquer.
rejected_translation: Divide and rule.
defect_description: The standard English equivalent of this political maxim is 'divide and conquer'.

chosen_translation: Power corrupts people.
rejected_translation: Power spoils people.
defect_description: 'Власть портит' echoes 'power corrupts'; 'spoils' is incorrect for this political aphorism.

chosen_translation: The opposition criticises the government.
rejected_translation: The opposition critiques the power.
defect_description: 'Власть' in political context = the government/authorities; 'critiques' is a noun-turned-verb calque.

chosen_translation: The deputy voted against the bill.
rejected_translation: The deputy voted against the law project.
defect_description: 'Законопроект' = bill (in parliamentary context); 'law project' is a literal false calque.

source: Реформа принесла результаты, хотя многие сомневались в её успехе.
chosen_translation: The reform brought results, although many doubted its success.
rejected_translation: The reform brought results.
defect_description: Concessive clause about initial doubts dropped.

source: Несмотря на давление, президент не изменил решения.
chosen_translation: Despite the pressure, the president did not change his decision.
rejected_translation: The president did not change his decision.
defect_description: Concessive clause 'несмотря на давление' dropped.

source: Граждане имеют право на свободу слова.
chosen_translation: Citizens have the right to freedom of speech.
rejected_translation: Citizens have the right on freedom of speech.
defect_description: 'Right to' is the correct collocation, not 'right on'.

chosen_translation: The political scandal shook the country.
rejected_translation: The political scandal shook the nation.
defect_description: 'Страна' = country; 'nation' can be used but is more formal/ethnic than the source suggests.

chosen_translation: The tax reform sparked controversy.
rejected_translation: The tax reform called disputes.
defect_description: 'Вызвала споры' = sparked controversy; 'called disputes' is a false calque.

chosen_translation: He is sympathetic to left-wing views.
rejected_translation: He sympathises to left views.
defect_description: 'Sympathetic to' is the correct collocation; 'left-wing' is the standard compound adjective.

chosen_translation: The party suffered a defeat at the elections.
rejected_translation: The party suffered defeat on elections.
defect_description: 'At the elections' requires definite article; 'on elections' is incorrect preposition.

chosen_translation: The constitution guarantees equal rights.
rejected_translation: Constitution guarantees equal laws.
defect_description: 'Права' = rights not laws; definite article required before 'constitution'.

chosen_translation: He joined the opposition.
rejected_translation: He attached himself to the opposition.
defect_description: 'Примкнул' = joined; 'attached himself' is literal and non-idiomatic.

chosen_translation: Corruption is eating away at the state.
rejected_translation: Corruption corrodes the state.
defect_description: 'Разъедает' idiomatically means eating away at; 'corrodes' is more technical/metallic.

chosen_translation: Sanctions hit the economy.
rejected_translation: Sanctions struck on the economy.
defect_description: 'Hit' is transitive without preposition; 'struck on' is ungrammatical.

chosen_translation: The people demand change.
rejected_translation: The nation demands changes.
defect_description: 'Народ' in this context is 'the people'; 'перемен' = change (singular sense); 'changes' implies multiple specific items.

chosen_translation: The voice of the people is the voice of God.
rejected_translation: Voice of nation is voice of god.
defect_description: 'Народ' = the people; articles required; 'God' is capitalised as proper noun.

chosen_translation: The situation reached a boiling point.
rejected_translation: The situation heated up to the limit.
defect_description: 'Накалилась до предела' maps to English idiom 'reached a boiling point'.

chosen_translation: He is an old hand at politics.
rejected_translation: He is a rubbed bagel in politics.
defect_description: 'Тёртый калач' = experienced person; English equivalent 'old hand'.

source: Переговоры зашли в тупик, но обе стороны не теряют надежды.
chosen_translation: The negotiations reached a deadlock, but both sides have not lost hope.
rejected_translation: The negotiations reached a deadlock.
defect_description: Second clause about continued hope dropped.

source: Несмотря на протесты, закон был принят большинством голосов.
chosen_translation: Despite the protests, the law was passed by a majority vote.
rejected_translation: The law was passed by a majority vote.
defect_description: Concessive clause 'несмотря на протесты' dropped.

source: Дипломаты провели встречу за закрытыми дверями.
chosen_translation: The diplomats held a meeting behind closed doors.
rejected_translation: The diplomats conducted meeting beyond closed doors.
defect_description: 'Behind closed doors' is the idiomatic expression; 'beyond' is incorrect; article missing.

chosen_translation: He gave testimony in court.
rejected_translation: He gave performances in court.
defect_description: 'Показания' in legal context = testimony not performances.

chosen_translation: The current issue requires an urgent solution.
rejected_translation: The actual problem requires urgent decision.
defect_description: 'Актуальный' = current/pressing, not actual; 'проблема' = issue/problem; 'решения' = solution not decision.

chosen_translation: The opposition leader took the floor.
rejected_translation: The opposition leader took the word.
defect_description: 'Взял слово' = took the floor to speak; 'took the word' is a literal calque.

chosen_translation: He put himself forward as a candidate.
rejected_translation: He moved forward his candidature.
defect_description: 'Выдвинул кандидатуру' = put forward as a candidate; 'candidature' is archaic; 'moved forward' is incorrect.

source: Правительство выделило средства на развитие образования.
chosen_translation: The government allocated funds for the development of education.
rejected_translation: Government has singled out means for developing of education.
defect_description: 'Выделило' = allocated; 'средства' = funds; 'singled out means' is a false calque; articles missing.

chosen_translation: Polls show growing support for the party.
rejected_translation: Polls indicate the growth of support of the party.
defect_description: 'Growing support for' is more natural than 'growth of support of'; 'show' vs 'indicate' is minor.

chosen_translation: The president signed a decree yesterday.
rejected_translation: The president has signed a decree yesterday.
defect_description: Specific past time 'yesterday' requires simple past, not present perfect.

source: Правозащитники требуют освободить всех политических заключённых.
chosen_translation: Human rights activists are demanding the release of all political prisoners.
rejected_translation: Human rights defenders demand to free all political prisoners.
defect_description: 'Правозащитники' = human rights activists; 'the release of' is the legal collocation.

chosen_translation: Peace talks have been ongoing for a month.
rejected_translation: Peaceful negotiations go on already a month.
defect_description: 'Peace talks' is the standard compound; present perfect required; 'for a month' not 'already a month'.

chosen_translation: The authorities declared a state of emergency.
rejected_translation: Authorities announced about emergency situation.
defect_description: 'Declared' not 'announced about'; 'state of emergency' is the correct legal phrase; article missing.

source: Его речь произвела большое впечатление на аудиторию.
chosen_translation: His speech made a great impression on the audience.
rejected_translation: His speech produced a big impression on the auditorium.
defect_description: 'Аудитория' in context of listeners = audience; 'auditorium' is the room; 'big impression' should be 'great impression'.

chosen_translation: Opponents of the reform staged a protest action.
rejected_translation: Opponents of the reform organized a stock action.
defect_description: 'Акция' in protest context = protest action; 'stock action' is a false friend (stocks/shares).

source: Закон направлен на борьбу с коррупцией.
chosen_translation: The law is aimed at fighting corruption.
rejected_translation: The law is directed to struggle with corruption.
defect_description: 'Aimed at' is the correct phrase; 'fighting corruption' is more natural than 'struggle with'.

source: Министр подал в отставку и заявил о причинах публично.
chosen_translation: The minister resigned and publicly stated his reasons.
rejected_translation: The minister resigned.
defect_description: Second clause about publicly stating reasons dropped.

chosen_translation: Despite the criticism, the reforms continued.
rejected_translation: The reforms continued.
defect_description: Concessive clause dropped.

chosen_translation: The party is gaining popularity among young people.
rejected_translation: The party gains popularity among youth.
defect_description: Ongoing trend uses present continuous; 'young people' is more natural than 'youth' in everyday contexts.

chosen_translation: He is running for mayor.
rejected_translation: He ballots for the mayor.
defect_description: 'Баллотируется в' = running for; 'ballots for' is a false calque from the Russian root.

chosen_translation: The decision was reached by consensus.
rejected_translation: The decision is taken by consensus.
defect_description: 'Принято консенсусом' = reached by consensus (completed action); simple past preferred.

source: Конституционный суд вынес решение, и оно вступило в силу немедленно.
chosen_translation: The Constitutional Court issued a ruling, and it took effect immediately.
rejected_translation: The Constitutional Court issued a ruling.
defect_description: Second clause about immediate effect dropped.
